title: Min-Fund Prison (Hard)
statementMd:
**In the hard version, $2 \leq \sum n \leq 10^5$ and $1 \leq \sum m \leq 5 \times 10^{5}$**

After a worker's strike organized by the Dementors asking for equal rights, the prison of Azkaban has suffered some damage. After settling the spirits, the Ministry of Magic is looking to renovate the prison to ensure that the Dementors are kept in check. The prison consists of $n$ prison cells and $m$ bi-directional corridors. The $i^{th}$ corridor is from cells $u_i$ to $v_i$. A subset of these cells $S$ is called a complex if any cell in $S$ is reachable from any other cell in $S$. Formally, a subset of cells $S$ is a complex if $x$ and $y$ are reachable from each other for all $x, y \in S$, using only cells from $S$ on the way. The funding required for a complex $S$ consisting of $k$ cells is defined as $k^2$.

As part of your *Intro to Magical Interior Design* course at Hogwarts, you have been tasked with designing the prison. The Ministry of Magic has asked that you divide the prison into $2$ complexes with $\textbf{exactly one corridor}$ connecting them, so that the Dementors can't organize union meetings. For this purpose, you are allowed to build bi-directional corridors. The funding required to build a corridor between any $2$ cells is $c$.

Due to budget cuts and the ongoing fight against the Death Eaters, you must find the $\textbf{minimum total funding}$ required to divide the prison as per the Ministry's requirements or $-1$ if no division is possible.

Note: The total funding is the sum of the funding required for the $2$ complexes and the corridors built. If after the division, the two complexes have $x$ and $y$ cells respectively and you have built a total of $a$ corridors, the total funding will be $x^2 + y^2 + c \times a$. Note that $x+y=n$.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $t$ ($1 \leq t \leq 10^5$) — the number of test cases. Then $t$ test cases follow.

The first line of each test case consists of three integers $n, m$ and $c$ ($2 \leq n \leq 10^5$, $1 \leq m \leq 5 \times 10^{5}$, $1 \leq c \leq 10^9$)

$m$ lines follow, each consisting of 2 integers — $u_i, v_i$ indicating a corridor is present between cells $u_i$ and $v_i$ ($1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq n$, $u_i \neq v_i$)

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $10^5$.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $m$ over all test cases does not exceed $5 \times 10^5$.

It is guaranteed that there exists at most one corridor between any two cells.

## Output

Print the $\textbf{minimum funding}$ required to divide the prison as per the Ministry's requirements or $-1$ if no division is possible.

## Note

In the first test case of the sample input, there is no way to divide the prison according to the Ministry's requirements.

In the second test case, consider the corridor between cells $1$ and $5$ as the connection between the $2$ complexes consisting of $\{2, 3, 5, 6\}$ and $\{1, 4\}$ cells respectively. There are no new corridors built. The total funding is $4^2 + 2^2 = 20$. You can verify this is the minimum funding required. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/59aaf1637bd3953312dad27f6ed95aa964f2e5c7.png)

In the third test case, build a corridor between $2$ and $4$. Consider the corridor between cells $1$ and $5$ as the connection between the $2$ complexes consisting of $\{3, 5, 6\}$ and $\{1, 2, 4\}$ cells respectively. The total funding is $3^2 + 3^2 + 7 \times 1 = 25$. You can verify this is the minimum funding required. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/462e6a40907dce74ec959a3beaca41e2e1dc749f.png)

In the fourth test case, build a corridor between $2$ and $4$ and between $5$ and $7$. Consider the corridor between cells $5$ and $7$ as the connection between the $2$ complexes consisting of $\{1, 2, 4, 7\}$ and $\{3, 5, 6\}$ cells respectively. The total funding is $4^2 + 3^2 + 4 \times 2 = 33$. You can verify this is the minimum funding required. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e4efed6eb7bb3929f4574047317a0783649b6f25.png)

Note for all test cases that there may be multiple ways to get the same funding but there is no other division which will have a more optimal minimum funding.
statementZhMd:
**在困难版本中，$2 \leq \sum n \leq 10^5$ 且 $1 \leq \sum m \leq 5 \times 10^{5}$**

在摄魂怪为争取平等权利而组织的一次工人罢工之后，阿兹卡班监狱遭受了一些损坏。在安抚了这些灵体之后，魔法部希望翻新监狱，以确保摄魂怪受到控制。监狱由 $n$ 个牢房和 $m$ 条双向走廊组成。第 $i$ 条走廊连接牢房 $u_i$ 和 $v_i$。如果一个牢房集合 $S$ 中的任意牢房都可以到达集合中的任意其他牢房，则称 $S$ 是一个复合区域。形式化地说，对于所有 $x, y \in S$，如果从 $x$ 到 $y$ 的路径上只使用 $S$ 中的牢房，则称牢房集合 $S$ 是一个复合区域。一个包含 $k$ 个牢房的复合区域 $S$ 所需的资金定义为 $k^2$。

作为霍格沃茨《魔法室内设计入门》课程的一部分，你被布置了设计这座监狱的任务。魔法部要求你将监狱划分为 $2$ 个复合区域，并且使连接它们的走廊**恰好有一条**，这样摄魂怪就无法组织工会会议。为此，你可以修建双向走廊。在任意 $2$ 个牢房之间修建一条走廊所需的资金为 $c$。

由于预算削减以及与食死徒的持续斗争，你必须找出满足魔法部要求的划分所需的**最小总资金**；如果无法完成划分，则输出 $-1$。

注意：总资金是 $2$ 个复合区域所需资金与修建走廊所需资金之和。如果划分后，两个复合区域分别有 $x$ 和 $y$ 个牢房，并且总共修建了 $a$ 条走廊，则总资金为 $x^2 + y^2 + c \times a$。注意 $x+y=n$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \leq t \leq 10^5$）——测试用例的数量。接下来是 $t$ 个测试用例。

每个测试用例的第一行包含三个整数 $n$、$m$ 和 $c$（$2 \leq n \leq 10^5$，$1 \leq m \leq 5 \times 10^{5}$，$1 \leq c \leq 10^9$）。

接下来 $m$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $u_i, v_i$，表示牢房 $u_i$ 和 $v_i$ 之间存在一条走廊（$1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq n$，$u_i \neq v_i$）。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $10^5$。

保证所有测试用例的 $m$ 之和不超过 $5 \times 10^5$。

保证任意两个牢房之间至多存在一条走廊。

## 输出格式

输出满足魔法部要求的划分所需的**最小资金**；如果无法完成划分，则输出 $-1$。

## 说明

在样例输入的第一个测试用例中，没有办法按照魔法部的要求划分监狱。

在第二个测试用例中，可以将连接牢房 $1$ 和 $5$ 的走廊作为连接两个复合区域的走廊，这两个复合区域分别由牢房集合 $\{2, 3, 5, 6\}$ 和 $\{1, 4\}$ 组成。不需要修建新的走廊。总资金为 $4^2 + 2^2 = 20$。可以验证这是所需的最小资金。 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/59aaf1637bd3953312dad27f6ed95aa964f2e5c7.png)

在第三个测试用例中，在牢房 $2$ 和 $4$ 之间修建一条走廊。可以将连接牢房 $1$ 和 $5$ 的走廊作为连接两个复合区域的走廊，这两个复合区域分别由牢房集合 $\{3, 5, 6\}$ 和 $\{1, 2, 4\}$ 组成。总资金为 $3^2 + 3^2 + 7 \times 1 = 25$。可以验证这是所需的最小资金。 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/462e6a40907dce74ec959a3beaca41e2e1dc749f.png)

在第四个测试用例中，在牢房 $2$ 和 $4$ 之间以及牢房 $5$ 和 $7$ 之间各修建一条走廊。可以将连接牢房 $5$ 和 $7$ 的走廊作为连接两个复合区域的走廊，这两个复合区域分别由牢房集合 $\{1, 2, 4, 7\}$ 和 $\{3, 5, 6\}$ 组成。总资金为 $4^2 + 3^2 + 4 \times 2 = 33$。可以验证这是所需的最小资金。 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e4efed6eb7bb3929f4574047317a0783649b6f25.png)

对于所有测试用例，可能存在多种获得相同资金的方式，但不存在其他能够达到更优最小资金的划分。
